name: test-checker
description: Audit and verify unit tests: blind spec-first test generation, dual-version execution (buggy vs fixed), and replacement of tests that enshrine bugs. Language-agnostic.

interface.longDescription: Generates tests blind from a specification, runs them against buggy and fixed versions, and flags tests that enshrine bugs instead of catching them.
defaultPrompt: Verify the tests for the function I just fixed.
Set up test-checker for this repo.
